package courseplan

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	domainservice "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/service"
)

func TestNormalizeGeneratedLessonContentCountsUnicodeTitles(t *testing.T) {
	title := strings.Repeat("я", 200)
	content := domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent{
		DescriptionMarkdown: "Описание",
		Examples: []domain.PlannedExample{{
			Title: title, DescriptionMarkdown: "Пример", Stacks: []string{"go"}, TargetConcepts: []string{"go.syntax"},
		}},
		KnowledgeChecks: []domain.PlannedTask{{
			Title: title, DescriptionMarkdown: "Вопрос", ExpectedAnswers: []string{"ответ"},
		}},
	}
	if err := normalizeGeneratedLessonContent(&content); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("valid Unicode title was rejected: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestGenerateCourseContentRenewsBeforeEveryLesson(t *testing.T) {
	course := domain.GeneratedCourse{
		Fingerprint: "fingerprint", Language: "ru",
		Modules: []domain.PlannedModule{{
			Code: "module", Sections: []domain.PlannedSection{{
				Code: "section", Lessons: []domain.PlannedLesson{{Code: "one", Title: "One"}, {Code: "two", Title: "Two"}},
			}},
		}},
	}
	renewals := 0
	_, err := GenerateCourseContent(
		context.Background(), processorContentGenerator{}, "request-id", course, json.RawMessage(`{}`),
		func(context.Context) error { renewals++; return nil },
	)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("generate content: %v", err)
	}
	if renewals != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("renewals=%d want=2", renewals)
	}
}
